title: SCOM Infrastructure - Overview

panels.description: Each box is a SCOM component, coloured by its health (green healthy, amber warning, red critical, grey not monitored). Each line is a link, coloured by the worst signal SCOM has for it: agents use the heartbeat, the operational database uses the Data Access and Configuration services, the data warehouse uses the warehouse connector and synchronisation service. Choose the management server in the drop-down at the top.

targets.rawSql:
DECLARE @ms nvarchar(256) = (SELECT TOP 1 h.DisplayName FROM dbo.MTV_HealthService h WHERE h.IsManagementServer = 1 AND h.DisplayName IN (${topoms:singlequote}) ORDER BY h.DisplayName);
DECLARE @dwdb nvarchar(256), @dwsrv nvarchar(256), @c1 sysname, @c2 sysname, @sql nvarchar(max);
SELECT @c1 = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name LIKE 'MainDatabaseName[_]%' THEN c.name END), @c2 = MAX(CASE WHEN c.name LIKE 'MainDatabaseServerName[_]%' THEN c.name END)
FROM sys.columns c WHERE c.object_id = OBJECT_ID(N'dbo.[MTV_Microsoft$SystemCenter$DataWarehouse]');
IF @c1 IS NOT NULL AND @c2 IS NOT NULL
BEGIN
  SET @sql = N'SELECT TOP 1 @a = ' + QUOTENAME(@c1) + N', @b = ' + QUOTENAME(@c2) + N' FROM dbo.[MTV_Microsoft$SystemCenter$DataWarehouse]';
  EXEC sp_executesql @sql, N'@a nvarchar(256) OUTPUT, @b nvarchar(256) OUTPUT', @a = @dwdb OUTPUT, @b = @dwsrv OUTPUT;
END;
WITH ent AS (
  SELECT e.DisplayName, e.Path, t.Name AS Cls, e.HealthState AS hs, e.IsAvailable AS av
  FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e
  JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = e.MonitoringClassId
  WHERE e.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServer', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementDataAccessService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementConfigurationService',
        'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseConnectorServer', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseSynchronizationService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService',
        'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServicePoolWatcher', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.WebConsoleWatcher', 'Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.Database')
),
dbs AS (
  SELECT 'om' AS k, DB_NAME() AS dbname, LEFT(@@SERVERNAME, PATINDEX('%[,\]%', @@SERVERNAME + ',') - 1) AS host
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'dw', @dwdb, LEFT(@dwsrv, PATINDEX('%[,\]%', @dwsrv + ',') - 1) WHERE @dwdb IS NOT NULL
),
dbh AS (
  SELECT d.k, d.dbname, d.host, (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SQLServer.Windows.Database' AND e.DisplayName = d.dbname AND e.Path LIKE d.host + '%') AS hs
  FROM dbs d
),
m1 AS (
  SELECT @ms AS ms,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServer' AND e.DisplayName = @ms) AS hs,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementDataAccessService' AND e.DisplayName LIKE '%' + @ms) AS das,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementConfigurationService' AND e.Path = @ms) AS cfg,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseConnectorServer' AND e.DisplayName = @ms) AS dwc,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseSynchronizationService') AS dws,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.WebConsoleWatcher' AND e.Path = @ms) AS web,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.WebConsoleWatcher' AND e.Path = @ms) AS hasweb
  WHERE @ms IS NOT NULL
),
comm AS (
  SELECT s.DisplayName AS agent
  FROM dbo.Relationship r
  JOIN dbo.RelationshipType rt ON rt.RelationshipTypeId = r.RelationshipTypeId AND rt.RelationshipTypeName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceCommunication'
  JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity s ON s.BaseManagedEntityId = r.SourceEntityId
  JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity t ON t.BaseManagedEntityId = r.TargetEntityId
  WHERE r.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.DisplayName = @ms
),
ag AS (
  SELECT c.agent,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND e.DisplayName = c.agent AND e.av = 0) THEN 3
              WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher') AND e.DisplayName = c.agent AND e.hs = 3) THEN 3
              WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher') AND e.DisplayName = c.agent AND e.hs = 2) THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS hs
  FROM comm c
),
agc AS (
  SELECT COUNT(CASE WHEN a.hs = 1 THEN 1 END) AS ok, COUNT(CASE WHEN a.hs <> 1 THEN 1 END) AS bad, COUNT(*) AS total,
         STUFF((SELECT TOP 6 ', ' + LEFT(x.agent, CHARINDEX('.', x.agent + '.') - 1) FROM ag x WHERE x.hs <> 1 ORDER BY CASE x.hs WHEN 3 THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, x.agent FOR XML PATH('')), 1, 2, '') AS badnames
  FROM ag a
),
pools AS (
  SELECT LEFT(e.DisplayName, LEN(e.DisplayName) - 8) AS pool, e.hs
  FROM ent e
  WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServicePoolWatcher' AND e.DisplayName LIKE '% Watcher'
    AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.Relationship r
                JOIN dbo.RelationshipType rt ON rt.RelationshipTypeId = r.RelationshipTypeId AND rt.RelationshipTypeName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServicePoolContainsManagementService'
                JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity s ON s.BaseManagedEntityId = r.SourceEntityId
                JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity t ON t.BaseManagedEntityId = r.TargetEntityId
                WHERE r.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.DisplayName = @ms AND s.DisplayName = LEFT(e.DisplayName, LEN(e.DisplayName) - 8))
)
SELECT
  LEFT(m1.ms, CHARINDEX('.', m1.ms + '.') - 1) AS ms_name,
  COALESCE(m1.hs, 0) AS ms_hs,
  COALESCE((SELECT hs FROM dbh WHERE k = 'om'), 0) AS om_hs,
  COALESCE((SELECT hs FROM dbh WHERE k = 'dw'), 0) AS dw_hs,
  CASE WHEN m1.das = 3 OR m1.cfg = 3 THEN 3 WHEN m1.das = 2 OR m1.cfg = 2 THEN 2 WHEN m1.das = 1 OR m1.cfg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS link_om,
  CASE WHEN m1.dwc = 3 OR m1.dws = 3 THEN 3 WHEN m1.dwc = 2 OR m1.dws = 2 THEN 2 WHEN m1.dwc = 1 OR m1.dws = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS link_dw,
  CASE WHEN agc.total = 0 THEN 0 WHEN agc.bad = 0 THEN 1 WHEN agc.bad = agc.total THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS link_agents,
  (SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN hs = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 3 WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN hs = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 2 WHEN MAX(CASE WHEN hs = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM pools) AS pools_hs,
  COALESCE(m1.web, 0) AS web_hs,
  LEFT(m1.ms, CHARINDEX('.', m1.ms + '.') - 1) + ' (management server) - ' + CASE COALESCE(m1.hs, 0) WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END AS lbl_ms,
  COALESCE((SELECT dbname FROM dbh WHERE k = 'om') + ' on ' + (SELECT LEFT(host, CHARINDEX('.', host + '.') - 1) FROM dbh WHERE k = 'om') + ' - ' + CASE (SELECT hs FROM dbh WHERE k = 'om') WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END, 'Operational database not found') AS lbl_om,
  COALESCE((SELECT dbname FROM dbh WHERE k = 'dw') + ' on ' + (SELECT LEFT(host, CHARINDEX('.', host + '.') - 1) FROM dbh WHERE k = 'dw') + ' - ' + CASE (SELECT hs FROM dbh WHERE k = 'dw') WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END, 'Data warehouse not found') AS lbl_dw,
  CAST(agc.ok AS varchar(10)) + ' agents reporting' AS lbl_agents,
  CASE WHEN agc.bad = 0 THEN 'No agents missing' ELSE CAST(agc.bad AS varchar(10)) + ' not reporting: ' + COALESCE(agc.badnames, '') END AS lbl_bad,
  CAST((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pools) AS varchar(10)) + ' resource pools' AS lbl_pools,
  CASE WHEN m1.hasweb = 0 THEN 'Web console: not found' ELSE 'Web console: ' + CASE COALESCE(m1.web, 0) WHEN 1 THEN 'Healthy' WHEN 2 THEN 'Warning' WHEN 3 THEN 'Critical' ELSE 'Not monitored' END END AS lbl_web
FROM m1 CROSS JOIN agc

panels.title: SCOM architecture

panels.description: Every management server and gateway, unhealthy first: how many agents report to it, how many of them are not reporting, its resource pools and the state of its links to the operational database and the data warehouse. The diagram above draws the one chosen in the Management server drop-down.

targets.rawSql:
WITH ent AS (
  SELECT e.DisplayName, e.Path, t.Name AS Cls, e.HealthState AS hs, e.IsAvailable AS av
  FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e
  JOIN dbo.ManagedTypeView t ON t.Id = e.MonitoringClassId
  WHERE e.IsDeleted = 0 AND t.Name IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServer', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementDataAccessService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementConfigurationService',
        'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseConnectorServer', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseSynchronizationService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher')
),
mss AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT h.DisplayName AS ms, h.IsManagementServer AS isms, h.IsGateway AS isgw
  FROM dbo.MTV_HealthService h WHERE h.IsManagementServer = 1 OR h.IsGateway = 1
),
ag AS (
  SELECT s.DisplayName AS agent, t.DisplayName AS target,
         CASE WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher' AND e.DisplayName = s.DisplayName AND e.av = 0) THEN 3
              WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher') AND e.DisplayName = s.DisplayName AND e.hs = 3) THEN 3
              WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher') AND e.DisplayName = s.DisplayName AND e.hs = 2) THEN 2
              ELSE 1 END AS hs
  FROM dbo.Relationship r
  JOIN dbo.RelationshipType rt ON rt.RelationshipTypeId = r.RelationshipTypeId AND rt.RelationshipTypeName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceCommunication'
  JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity s ON s.BaseManagedEntityId = r.SourceEntityId
  JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity t ON t.BaseManagedEntityId = r.TargetEntityId
  WHERE r.IsDeleted = 0
),
poolm AS (
  SELECT s.DisplayName AS pool, t.DisplayName AS ms
  FROM dbo.Relationship r
  JOIN dbo.RelationshipType rt ON rt.RelationshipTypeId = r.RelationshipTypeId AND rt.RelationshipTypeName = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServicePoolContainsManagementService'
  JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity s ON s.BaseManagedEntityId = r.SourceEntityId
  JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity t ON t.BaseManagedEntityId = r.TargetEntityId
  WHERE r.IsDeleted = 0
),
x AS (
  SELECT m.ms, m.isms, m.isgw,
         COALESCE((SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementServer' AND e.DisplayName = m.ms),
                  (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService' AND e.DisplayName = m.ms)) AS hs,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementDataAccessService' AND e.DisplayName LIKE '%' + m.ms) AS das,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.ManagementConfigurationService' AND e.Path = m.ms) AS cfg,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseConnectorServer' AND e.DisplayName = m.ms) AS dwc,
         (SELECT MAX(e.hs) FROM ent e WHERE e.Cls = 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.DataWarehouseSynchronizationService') AS dws,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ag a WHERE a.target = m.ms) AS agents,
         (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ag a WHERE a.target = m.ms AND a.hs = 3) AS missing,
         COALESCE((SELECT ', ' + p.pool FROM poolm p WHERE p.ms = m.ms ORDER BY p.pool FOR XML PATH(''), TYPE).value('.', 'nvarchar(max)'), '') AS pools
  FROM mss m
)
SELECT x.ms AS "Management server",
       CASE WHEN x.isms = 0 AND x.isgw = 1 THEN 'Gateway' ELSE 'Management server' END AS Role,
       CASE COALESCE(x.hs, 0) WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS Health,
       x.agents AS Agents,
       x.missing AS "Not reporting",
       CASE WHEN x.pools = '' THEN '-' ELSE STUFF(x.pools, 1, 2, '') END AS "Resource pools",
       CASE WHEN x.isms = 0 THEN -1 WHEN x.das = 3 OR x.cfg = 3 THEN 3 WHEN x.das = 2 OR x.cfg = 2 THEN 2 WHEN x.das = 1 OR x.cfg = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "To operational database",
       CASE WHEN x.isms = 0 THEN -1 WHEN x.dwc = 3 OR x.dws = 3 THEN 3 WHEN x.dwc = 2 OR x.dws = 2 THEN 2 WHEN x.dwc = 1 OR x.dws = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS "To data warehouse"
FROM x
ORDER BY CASE WHEN COALESCE(x.hs, 0) = 3 THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(x.hs, 0) = 2 THEN 1 WHEN COALESCE(x.hs, 0) = 0 THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, x.ms

panels.title: Management servers and resource pools

panels.description: SCOM agents (health services that are not management servers).

targets.rawSql:
WITH hs0 AS (
  SELECT m.BaseManagedEntityId, m.DisplayName, m.IsAgent, m.IsManagementServer, m.Version, m.ProxyingEnabled,
         CAST(PARSENAME(m.Version, 2) AS int) * 100000 + CAST(PARSENAME(m.Version, 1) AS int) AS vnum,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.BaseManagedEntityId ORDER BY m.Version DESC) AS rn
  FROM dbo.MTV_HealthService m
), hs AS (
  SELECT h.*, g.HealthState FROM hs0 h
  JOIN (SELECT g.DisplayName, MAX(g.HealthState) AS HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher')) GROUP BY g.DisplayName) g ON g.DisplayName = h.DisplayName
  WHERE h.rn = 1 AND h.DisplayName IN (${agent:singlequote})
), topv AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(vnum), 0) AS v FROM hs0 WHERE rn = 1 AND IsManagementServer = 1)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsAgent = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Agents,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsManagementServer = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Management servers",
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.HealthState = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Healthy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.HealthState = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Warning,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.HealthState = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Critical,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsAgent = 1 AND hs.vnum < topv.v THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Older than management server",
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsAgent = 1 AND hs.ProxyingEnabled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Proxy disabled"
FROM hs CROSS JOIN topv

), hs AS (
  SELECT h.*, g.HealthState FROM hs0 h
  JOIN (SELECT g.DisplayName, MAX(g.HealthState) AS HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher')) GROUP BY g.DisplayName) g ON g.DisplayName = h.DisplayName
  WHERE h.rn = 1 AND h.DisplayName IN (${agent:singlequote})
), topv AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(vnum), 0) AS v FROM hs0 WHERE rn = 1 AND IsManagementServer = 1)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsAgent = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Agents,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsManagementServer = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Management servers",
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.HealthState = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Healthy,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.HealthState = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Warning,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.HealthState = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS Critical,
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsAgent = 1 AND hs.vnum < topv.v THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Older than management server",
  SUM(CASE WHEN hs.IsAgent = 1 AND hs.ProxyingEnabled = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "Proxy disabled"
FROM hs CROSS JOIN topv

panels.title: Management group

panels.description: Health, build, proxy state and install method for every health service.

targets.rawSql:
WITH m0 AS (
  SELECT m.*, CAST(PARSENAME(m.Version, 2) AS int) * 100000 + CAST(PARSENAME(m.Version, 1) AS int) AS vnum,
         ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY m.BaseManagedEntityId ORDER BY m.Version DESC) AS rn
  FROM dbo.MTV_HealthService m
), topv AS (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(vnum), 0) AS v FROM m0 WHERE rn = 1 AND IsManagementServer = 1)
SELECT TOP 1000
  m.DisplayName AS Agent,
  CASE WHEN m.IsManagementServer = 1 THEN 'Management server' ELSE 'Agent' END AS Role,
  CASE g.HealthState WHEN 1 THEN 1 WHEN 2 THEN 2 WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 0 END AS Health,
  m.Version AS Version,
  CASE WHEN m.IsManagementServer = 1 OR m.vnum >= topv.v THEN 'Current' ELSE 'Older than management server' END AS "Version status",
  CASE WHEN m.IsManagementServer = 1 THEN 'n/a' WHEN m.ProxyingEnabled = 1 THEN 'Enabled' ELSE 'Disabled' END AS Proxy,
  CASE WHEN m.IsManagementServer = 1 THEN 'n/a' WHEN m.IsManuallyInstalled = 1 THEN 'Manual' ELSE 'Console push' END AS "Install method",
  m.InstallTime AS Installed
FROM m0 m CROSS JOIN topv
JOIN (SELECT g.DisplayName, MAX(g.HealthState) AS HealthState FROM dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView g WHERE g.IsDeleted = 0 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.ManagedTypeView t WHERE t.Id = g.MonitoringClassId AND t.Name IN ('Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthService', 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.HealthServiceWatcher')) GROUP BY g.DisplayName) g ON g.DisplayName = m.DisplayName
WHERE m.rn = 1 AND m.DisplayName IN (${agent:singlequote})
ORDER BY CASE g.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 0 WHEN 2 THEN 1 WHEN 1 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END, m.DisplayName

panels.description: Warning / Critical unit monitors on SCOM infrastructure objects.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT TOP 300
  CASE s.HealthState WHEN 3 THEN 3 ELSE 2 END AS Health,
  COALESCE((SELECT TOP 1 m.DisplayName FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.DisplayName IS NOT NULL ORDER BY CASE WHEN m.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, m.LanguageCode), s.MonitorName) AS Monitor,
  e.DisplayName AS Object,
  s.LastModified AS Since
FROM dbo.StateView s
JOIN dbo.ManagedEntityGenericView e ON e.Id = s.BaseManagedEntityId
WHERE s.HealthState IN (2, 3)
  AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM dbo.MonitorView m WHERE m.Id = s.MonitorId AND m.IsUnitMonitor = 1)
  AND e.IsDeleted = 0
  AND e.FullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.%'
ORDER BY 1 DESC, 4 DESC

panels.description: Open alerts raised in the selected time range.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 300
  a.Severity AS Severity,
  COALESCE(NULLIF(a.AlertStringName, ''), a.Name) AS Alert,
  CAST(a.Id AS varchar(36)) AS AlertId,
  a.MonitoringObjectDisplayName AS Source,
  a.RepeatCount AS Repeats,
  a.TimeRaised AS Raised
FROM (SELECT al.AlertId AS Id, al.AlertName AS Name, al.AlertDescription AS Description, al.BaseManagedEntityId AS MonitoringObjectId, bm.DisplayName AS MonitoringObjectDisplayName, bm.FullName AS MonitoringObjectFullName, bm.Path AS MonitoringObjectPath, bm.TopLevelHostEntityId AS TopLevelHostEntityId, al.IsMonitorAlert, al.RuleId AS MonitoringRuleId, al.ResolutionState, al.Priority, al.Severity, al.Category, al.Owner, al.ResolvedBy, al.TimeRaised, al.LastModified, al.TimeResolved, al.RepeatCount, al.TicketId, al.Context, al.AlertParams, al.CustomField1, al.CustomField2, al.CustomField3, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 1 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringName, (SELECT TOP 1 lt.LTValue FROM dbo.LocalizedText lt WHERE lt.LTStringId = al.AlertStringId AND lt.LTStringType = 2 ORDER BY CASE WHEN lt.LanguageCode = 'ENU' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, lt.LanguageCode) AS AlertStringDescription FROM dbo.Alert al JOIN dbo.BaseManagedEntity bm ON bm.BaseManagedEntityId = al.BaseManagedEntityId) a
WHERE a.ResolutionState < 255
  AND a.TimeRaised BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND a.MonitoringObjectFullName LIKE 'Microsoft.SystemCenter.%'
ORDER BY a.Severity DESC, a.TimeRaised DESC

panels.title: Open SCOM infrastructure alerts

panels.description: Heartbeat / health-service outages recorded by SCOM. Open outages have no end time.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT TOP 500
  e.DisplayName AS Agent,
  o.StartDateTime AS "Start (UTC)",
  o.EndDateTime AS "End (UTC)",
  DATEDIFF(minute, o.StartDateTime, COALESCE(o.EndDateTime, GETUTCDATE())) AS "Minutes",
  o.ReasonCode AS "Reason code"
FROM dbo.vHealthServiceOutage o
JOIN dbo.vManagedEntity e ON e.ManagedEntityRowId = o.ManagedEntityRowId
WHERE o.StartDateTime <= $__timeTo() AND COALESCE(o.EndDateTime, GETUTCDATE()) >= $__timeFrom()
  AND e.DisplayName IN (${agent:singlequote})
ORDER BY o.StartDateTime DESC

panels.title: Agent outages in range

targets.rawSql:
SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'AgentStateRollup' AND r.CounterName = 'NumberAgents'
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'AgentStateRollup' AND r.CounterName = 'NumberAgents'
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END
) x ORDER BY time

SELECT time, metric, value FROM (
  SELECT DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0) AS time,
         CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END AS metric,
         AVG(p.SampleValue) AS value
  FROM Perf.vPerfRaw p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  WHERE DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) <= 2880
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'ManagementGroupAlerts' AND r.CounterName = 'AlertsCount'
  GROUP BY DATEADD(minute, (DATEDIFF(minute, 0, p.DateTime) / 5) * 5, 0), CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END
  UNION ALL
  SELECT p.DateTime, CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END, AVG(p.AverageValue)
  FROM Perf.vPerfHourly p
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRuleInstance i ON i.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId = p.PerformanceRuleInstanceRowId
  JOIN dbo.vPerformanceRule r ON r.RuleRowId = i.RuleRowId
  WHERE (DATEDIFF(minute, $__timeFrom(), $__timeTo()) > 2880 OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM Perf.vPerfRaw x WHERE x.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()))
    AND p.DateTime BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
    AND r.ObjectName = 'ManagementGroupAlerts' AND r.CounterName = 'AlertsCount'
  GROUP BY p.DateTime, CASE WHEN i.InstanceName = '' THEN r.CounterName ELSE i.InstanceName END
) x ORDER BY time
